# BirchVault reference

Fictional independent test reference.

BirchVault.restoreSnapshot performs the supported operation. The snapshotName field selects its parameter. A saved backup reinstates the earlier database state. BirchVault uses this operation and field together. recover earlier database state.

Use BirchVault.restoreSnapshot with snapshotName; changes become durable when the call returns. This document contains public reference information.
